about: Made by glazier-core's conformance.test.ts from catalog/database.ts, a catalog it creates; do not edit. Frozen when Electron Oriel and glazier-core were removed (plan 063): Oriel RS's engine is the only implementation, and this is what it must still produce. Non-ASCII characters are escaped.

master.sql: CREATE INDEX files_size ON files (size)

master.name: duplicate_dismissal_files
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE duplicate_dismissal_files (
    dismissal_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES duplicate_dismissals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (dismissal_id, file_id)
  )

master.name: duplicate_dismissals
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE duplicate_dismissals (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    root_id INTEGER REFERENCES roots(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    plan_id INTEGER REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

master.name: empty_folders
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE empty_folders (
    root_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES roots(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    rel_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (root_id, rel_path)
  )

master.name: encode_timings
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE encode_timings (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    encoder TEXT NOT NULL,
    pixels INTEGER NOT NULL,
    media_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    wall_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

master.name: file_details
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE file_details (
    file_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES files(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mtime_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    print BLOB,
    error TEXT
  )

master.name: files
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE files (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    root_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES roots(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    rel_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    dir TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    ext TEXT NOT NULL,
    size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mtime_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    ctime_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    dev TEXT NOT NULL,
    ino TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_junk INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_seen_scan INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    format TEXT,
    ext_mismatch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    probe_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    probe_error TEXT,
    width INTEGER,
    height INTEGER,
    frames INTEGER,
    has_alpha INTEGER,
    duration_ms REAL,
    video_codec TEXT,
    audio_codec TEXT,
    audio_streams INTEGER,
    bitrate REAL,
    head_hash TEXT,
    sha256 TEXT,
    fingerprint_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    fingerprint TEXT,
    fingerprint_error TEXT,
    loudness_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    loudness_max_db REAL, optimize_not_smaller INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, shrink_not_smaller INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    UNIQUE (root_id, rel_path)
  )

master.name: holding
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE holding (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    root_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES roots(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    original_rel TEXT NOT NULL,
    hold_rel TEXT NOT NULL,
    batch TEXT NOT NULL,
    size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    held_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    plan_id INTEGER,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'held'
  , hold_path TEXT, batch_path TEXT)

master.name: plan_steps
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_steps (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    root_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES roots(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    from_rel TEXT NOT NULL,
    to_abs TEXT,
    spec TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expected_mtime_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    expected_ctime_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    message TEXT,
    bytes_before INTEGER NOT NULL,
    bytes_after INTEGER,
    holding_id INTEGER,
    output_mtime_ms REAL,
    done_at INTEGER,
    undone_at INTEGER
  )

master.name: plans
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE plans (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL
  , count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

master.name: roots
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE roots (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    added_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_scan_at INTEGER
  )

master.name: settings
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE settings (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
  )

master.name: sqlite_sequence
master.sql: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)
